methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search table saw models spanning jobsite, contractor, cabinet, and hybrid categories from 2009-2020. All 11 models were independently re-verified to exist as real, currently-sold products. Specifications were sourced from manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, SawStop, Bosch, Metabo HPT, Powermatic, SKIL/Skilsaw, RIDGID, Delta) and corroborated against authorized-dealer spec sheets (Tool Nut, Ohio Power Tool, CPO Power Tools, Acme Tools, Woodcraft, Rockler, McCoy's) and independent reviews (Pro Tool Reviews). Prices reflect verified current US retail or published MSRP as of June 2026; two prices were corrected downward after dealer cross-checks (DWE7485 449->399, C10RJS 649->599). Booleans are used only for flesh_detection (true = blade-stop safety system, false = absent); all dimension strings carry imperial units; motor is expressed as amps for corded AC tools and volts for cordless battery tools. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Note: several release years (RIDGID R4514, SKILSAW SPT99-11, Metabo HPT C10RJS) reflect best-available model-introduction estimates and could not be pinned to the exact year from primary sources.

products.name: DeWalt DWE7491RS 10-in Jobsite Table Saw with Rolling Stand

products.name: DeWalt DWE7485 8-1/4-in Compact Jobsite Table Saw
products.priceNote: Corrected: consistent tool-only retail $349-399, multiple US retailers June 2026
products.provenance: CORRECTED PRICE 449->399. Blade (8.25 in), rip capacity (24.5 in right / 12 in left), and 15 A motor confirmed from DeWalt official page. Tool-only retail consistently $349-399 (Burns $349, Lowe's/Amazon ~$369-399); $449 was overstated. Set to $399 (top of consistent range).

products.name: SawStop PCS31230-TGP236 3HP Professional Cabinet Saw with 36-in T-Glide Fence
products.priceNote: Tool Nut / multi-dealer retail, June 2026; fence-and-rails package
products.provenance: VERIFIED. Motor (3 HP, 13 A, 230 V), rip capacity right (36.5 in), depth of cut at 90 deg (3.125 in), 4 in dust port confirmed from CPO/Tool Nut spec sheets and SawStop page. products.priceNote: Retail at CPO Power Tools and Menards, June 2026
